text_zh: 其音既起，永不复归。连祷不绝者，沙漏亦随之延展——惟震颤能断此链。
text_en: Once begun, the litany knows no end. The hourglass expands with each prayer—save tremor breaks the chain.

text_zh:
圣印 · 不断之链
分级: Apollyon
发现地点: 第███层 熔变誓门活动痕迹
描述: 观测到连续祷击可维持跨层传导。每次铭刻成功后，下一层初始流沙流量将等同当前连祷深度。收容震颤仍可中断传导链。
来源推测: ████████熔变仪式残留物
备注: 该物品已被第██代守卷人议会明确列入禁制清单。当前征用需██级授权。使用者失联率: █████%。
text_en:
Sigil of Perpetual Chain
Object Class: Apollyon
Recovery Site: Layer ███, traces of Molten Verse activity
Description: Observed to maintain cross-layer conductivity through sustained litany-strikes. Upon successful inscription, subsequent layer's initial hourglass humour equals current prayer depth. Containment tremors still interrupt the chain.
Origin Theory: ████████ molten ritual remnant
Note: Explicitly prohibited by ██th Keeper Council. Current requisition requires Level-██ clearance. Operator casualty rate: █████%.
